caseName: Kilpatrick v. Choctaw, Oklahoma & Gulf Railroad
caseNameFull: Minnie Kilpatrick, in Error v. The Choctaw, Oklahoma and Gulf Railroad Company
summary: In error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. W. O. Davis for plaintiff in error., Mr. J. W. McLoud for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs, on the authority of Southern Pacific Company v. Seley, 152 U. S. 145, and case remanded to the United States court for the Central District of the Indian Territory.
